tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rtsa gsum don khrid kyi gsol 'debs bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ru/ dmigs med spros bral bde chen zhing khams der// chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs// blo 'das chos sku thob par byin gyis rlobs// shar phyogs ri bo ta la'i pho brang du// longs sku spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs// 'od gsal lhun grub rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su// sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs// tshe 'dir rig 'dzin thob par byin gyis rlobs// nyi shu rtsa bzhi mkha' 'gro'i gnas mchog tu// mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la gsol ba 'debs// bde stong zung 'jug rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// chos 'khor bde chen gling gi pho brang du// gter ston rat+na gling pa la gsol ba 'debs// bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// spyi gtsug nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng du// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// bdag rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs// gnas mchog khyung chen brag gi shar phyogs su// dam chos rtsa gsum don khrid la gsol ba 'debs// dngos po'i gshis lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// lhun grub rnam dag gsang ba'i gzhal yas su// yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// rang byung lhun grub rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// phrin las gtad rgya dam tshig pho brang du// bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs// phyi nang bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// gar bzhugs 'bral med dag pa'i gzhal yas su// mched grogs chos mdzad yongs la gsol ba 'debs// thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par byin gyis rlobs// sku gsum rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs/ gnyis 'dzin blo dang bral bar byin gyis rlobs// dag snang phyogs med 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// sgrub pa'i rgyal sa zin par byin gyis rlobs// 'khor bcas tshe 'dir grol bar byin gyis rlobs//
zhes gsol ba gdab par bya'o// //
